title: Solace - Server Binding v0.4.0
description: Contains server connection information about the Solace broker

bindingVersion.description: The version of this binding. If omitted, "latest" MUST be assumed

clientName.description: A unique client name to use to register to the appliance. If specified, it must be a valid Topic name, and a maximum of 160 bytes in length when encoded as UTF-8

msgVpn.description: The name of the Virtual Private Network to connect to on the Solace broker
